MindWanderer:

We've definitely deduced that orders with art prints have not gone out yet. It's odd that >G hasn't admitted this yet, but hopefully they'll come clean about it after GenCon.

My best guess, and it's just that, a guess: They don't know yet, or didn't as of the last update.

Not sure how the whole process has been working, but I've seen some images of the boxes the Kickstarter orders have come in, and I think they all say Group A (or whatever letter) with a list of the contents, so I'm guessing the contents of the box determine what Group a package is labeled as. And, maybe during the shipping process, the GTG folks would just see a box, and with whatever software they were using, filter by box letter, then grab the earliest backer number left who matches that box letter, print out the label and slap it on. I could see if in going through the motions of the process such as this, no one really noticed that box letters with the art prints weren't coming up. And if the factory in China didn't tell them that U.S. packages with the art prints haven't gone out yet, they might not realize it yet, until they start to read fans' comments. I actually wonder about the 10% of U.S.-based, non-collector's case orders that didn't go out in this first wave: Were those also orders that included the art prints? Not sure if that's been discussed, but maybe all U.S. orders with the art prints have been held up?

Another reason they may not have admitted this yet: Perhaps they are afraid of all the people who would say (and, let's face it, I'd be one of them): "I don't want the art prints then; just ship my order without the art prints and let a later backer have my art prints for free." Perhaps that would be too much of a logistical nightmare, so they wanted to avoid people requesting that. Still, though, GTG has been pretty transparent about this Kickstarter project of late, so I doubt that's the reason, but I could understand the hesitance if/when they found out. But, as you said, hopefully we'll know more once GenCon is over. Wish I could be there!

Anyway, if it is indeed the art prints that are holding things up, I so hope they are on the second wave at least. I can't wait to get OblivAeon! My nephew (who I introduced to Sentinels) is moving out to my city to go to college (from California to Texas), and it'd be nice to get in at least one game before he starts to have a heavy time commitment with school.
